prescription: Amoxicilline 1 g : 1 cp x 2/j pendant 7 jours, au milieu des repas.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Amoxicillin 1 g
What it is for: An antibiotic that kills the bacteria causing your infection.
How to take it: 1 tablet twice a day (morning and evening), in the middle of a meal, for 7 days. Finish all 7 days even if you feel better.
What to avoid: Tell your doctor if you are allergic to penicillin. Stop and get help if you get a rash, swelling or trouble breathing.

prescription: Paracétamol 1 g : 1 cp toutes les 6 h si douleur ou fièvre, max 4 cp/j.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Paracetamol 1 g
What it is for: Reduces pain and fever.
How to take it: 1 tablet only when you have pain or fever. Wait at least 6 hours between tablets. Never take more than 4 tablets in one day.
What to avoid: Do not take other medicines that also contain paracetamol (many cold and flu products do). Avoid alcohol.

prescription: Oméprazole 20 mg : 1 gél le matin à jeun pendant 14 jours.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Omeprazole 20 mg
What it is for: Lowers the acid in your stomach to protect it and ease heartburn.
How to take it: 1 capsule every morning on an empty stomach (before breakfast), for 14 days. Swallow it whole.
What to avoid: Spicy food, alcohol and smoking can make stomach problems worse.

prescription: Metformine 850 mg : 1 cp matin et soir au cours des repas. QSP 3 mois.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Metformin 850 mg
What it is for: Helps control the sugar level in your blood (diabetes).
How to take it: 1 tablet in the morning and 1 in the evening, during a meal. The prescription covers 3 months of treatment.
What to avoid: Avoid drinking a lot of alcohol. Tell your doctor before any scan with contrast dye or any surgery.

prescription: Ibuprofène 400 mg : 1 cp x 3/j pendant 5 jours après les repas. Ne pas dépasser 1200 mg/j.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Ibuprofen 400 mg
What it is for: Reduces pain, swelling and fever.
How to take it: 1 tablet 3 times a day, after meals, for 5 days. Never more than 3 tablets in one day.
What to avoid: Do not take it on an empty stomach. Do not take it with other anti-inflammatory medicines (like aspirin). Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or have stomach ulcers or kidney problems.

prescription: Amlodipine 5 mg : 1 cp/j le matin. Traitement au long cours.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Amlodipine 5 mg
What it is for: Lowers your blood pressure.
How to take it: 1 tablet every morning. This is a long-term treatment: do not stop it on your own, even if you feel fine.
What to avoid: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice. Get up slowly if you feel dizzy.

prescription: Ventoline 100 µg : 2 bouffées en cas de gêne respiratoire, à renouveler si besoin. Max 8 bouffées/j.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Ventolin (salbutamol) inhaler 100 micrograms
What it is for: Opens your airways quickly when you have trouble breathing (asthma).
How to take it: 2 puffs when you feel short of breath. You can repeat if needed, but never more than 8 puffs in one day.
What to avoid: If you need it more and more often, or it stops helping, see your doctor quickly.

prescription: Augmentin 1 g/125 mg : 1 sachet x 3/j pendant 8 jours au début des repas.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Augmentin (amoxicillin + clavulanic acid) 1 g/125 mg
What it is for: An antibiotic that treats a bacterial infection.
How to take it: 1 sachet mixed in water, 3 times a day, at the start of a meal, for 8 days. Finish the whole treatment.
What to avoid: Tell your doctor if you are allergic to penicillin. It can upset your stomach or cause diarrhea.

prescription: Levothyrox 50 µg : 1 cp le matin à jeun, 30 min avant le petit-déjeuner.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Levothyrox (levothyroxine) 50 micrograms
What it is for: Replaces the thyroid hormone your body does not make enough of.
How to take it: 1 tablet every morning on an empty stomach, 30 minutes before breakfast, with a glass of water.
What to avoid: Do not take it at the same time as iron, calcium or stomach-acid medicines; space them by a few hours.

prescription: Cétirizine 10 mg : 1 cp le soir pendant 10 jours.
reference_explanation:
Medicine: Cetirizine 10 mg
What it is for: An anti-allergy medicine that calms sneezing, runny nose and itching.
How to take it: 1 tablet every evening for 10 days.
What to avoid: It may make you sleepy, so be careful when driving. Avoid alcohol.
